description.value:
Scorpio — 2nd Technique, gained at level 6.

The scarlet haze that comes before Antares.

The target must attempt a Will save.

Failure For 1 minute it is dazzled, treats all other creatures as concealed, and takes 1d6 mental damage per needle it currently has at the end of each of its turns.

Critical Failure As failure, and it is confused for 1 round as the mirage overtakes it entirely.

Heightening (+2 levels) At 10th, 14th, and 18th level, the per-needle damage increases by 1d6.

On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher.

system.requirements: The target has at least 1 needle.

target.value: one creature with at least 1 needle
